description: A braced multi-statement event handler whose first statement is an unhandled call to a `!` function. E-ERROR-002 fires once — the same answer the one-statement forms get (see handler-unhandled-failable-one-stmt-pos / -bare-and-expr-pos).
rationale: §19.4.3 / §19.4.4 — an unhandled `!` call SHALL be E-ERROR-002, and nothing exempts an event-handler value. The answer follows the unhandled call, not the handler's statement count or form.
